Bilen rullar in en tidig dag,
med små bekymmer och stort behag.
Lyften höjs, och hjulen snurrar,
inspektören tittar, lyssnar, funderar.
Lampor blinkar, bromsar tar,
allt får svar på sina frågor kvar.
Avgaser mäts och rutor ses,
varje liten detalj noga läses.
Snart går färden vidare igen,
trygg på vägen, hemåt sen.

turns.reply: If the statutory emissions measurement was already done during maintenance, bring the measurement certificate to the inspection. It must be no more than 3 months old and intended for use at the inspection.

turns.reply: Yes, it may be possible, depending on the model and body type. It usually requires reducing the number of seats, and the inspector should check the plan before you make any modifications. after the changes, the vehicle needs a modification inspection.

turns.user: How often should I replace the wiper blades?
turns.reply: Wiper blades should usually be replaced about once a year, or every six months if you drive a lot. Replace them sooner if they stop wiping well, since worn blades can scratch the windshield.

turns.user: Mitä aikoja on huomenna, paljonko maksaa, mihin asti olette auki ja onko Kuopiossa asema?
turns.reply:
Huomenna Palokassa vapaita aikoja klo 11.00, 11.45 ja 12.15. Katsastus mittauksineen maksaa 76 €, näihin vihreisiin aikoihin verkossa maksettuna 71 €. asema on auki klo 9–17.

Kuopiossa on K1 Katsastus Kuopio Sorsasalo, Virranniementie 14. Se on huomenna auki klo 8–17, ja varaat ajan tästä: https://ajanvaraus.k1katsastus.fi/?stationId=1512 Asemalla: 63 €.

turns.user: Why are there two items in the booking?
turns.reply: The booking lists the periodic inspection and the statutory emissions test separately. For most combustion cars registered after August 1976, the emissions test is required and is normally done during the inspection.
